text: Zik studied the spiral-drop that appeared among the characters.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: You once told me it was a royal emblem.
speaker: Zik

text: I was wrong.
speaker: Ninsun

text: Ninsun's voice had gone flat.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: It is a claim of ownership. Not chosen. Assigned.
speaker: Ninsun

text: The man in the alcove spoke before she could continue.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: I know what it means when the mark chooses someone.
speaker: The Man Who Refused

text: Zik turned.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: Then say it.
speaker: Zik

text: You would not believe me.
speaker: The Man Who Refused

text: Try.
speaker: Zik

text: The man's cloudy eyes held his.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: You are already doing what your father did. He believed knowing the truth would make him free of it.
speaker: The Man Who Refused

text: The words landed with the weight of an unpaid account. Zik said nothing. He had spent twelve years carrying the shape of that belief; hearing it spoken by a stranger did not make it lighter.
speaker: Narrator

text: Ninsun reached the final section. The characters here had been cut with force rather than patience. Several surrounding blocks were cracked. She read the first line once, then again, then stopped breathing.
speaker: Narrator

text: What does it say?
speaker: Balag

text: Balag asked.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: She looked at Zik. Whatever he saw in her face drained the last of the anger from his expression.
speaker: Narrator

text: The First City was not the first city.
speaker: Ninsun

text: Silence settled over the alcove the way dust settles after a collapse.
speaker: Narrator

text: Then the stone moved.
speaker: Narrator

text: A thin groove appeared beneath the final line and carved itself into the black rock without tool or hand. Another line formed beside it. Then another. The City was writing—or correcting.
speaker: Narrator

text: Ninsun translated as the words appeared.
speaker: Narrator

text: The first city was built over the second.
speaker: Ninsun

text: A new line.
speaker: Narrator

text: The second was built over the third.
speaker: Ninsun

text: Her breathing quickened.
speaker: Narrator

text: The third was built over the—
speaker: Ninsun

text: She stopped.
speaker: Narrator

text: Zik stepped closer.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: Over what?
speaker: Zik

text: Ninsun stared at the final symbol.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: The word is present. But there is no place beneath it. No chamber. No city. No depth. Nothing the language is willing to name.
speaker: Ninsun

text: The man in the alcove spoke softly.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: Do not ask what lies beneath the last city.
speaker: The Man Who Refused

text: Zik turned.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: Why?
speaker: Zik

text: For the first time the man's composure cracked. His eyes shifted toward the darkness beyond the alcove, and something that resembled genuine fear moved across the wasted face.
speaker: Narrator

text: Because it may hear you.
speaker: The Man Who Refused

text: The first knock sounded from somewhere beyond the chamber.
speaker: Narrator

text: Three measured strikes. Not loud. Not hurried. The sound traveled through the black stone without echoing, through the soles of their feet and the bones of their bodies.
speaker: Narrator

text: Ninsun turned slowly toward Zik. He was staring at his left hand.
speaker: Narrator

text: The mark beneath the linen pulsed—not with his heartbeat. The spiral and the drop had darkened until they were almost black. Beneath the symbol the flesh of his palm began to rise. A thin line appeared under the skin, pushing upward from somewhere deeper than muscle or bone.
speaker: Narrator

text: Then the line moved.
speaker: Narrator

text: A single knock sounded against the inside of his palm.
speaker: Narrator

text: The man closed his eyes.
speaker: Narrator

text: Ninsun's voice dropped to a whisper.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: The knocks are not coming from the walls anymore.
speaker: Ninsun

text: Zik looked at her.
